# Contact symbols

These marks identify the owner's email destinations and professional profiles.
Each belongs to its respective institute or company. Source assets are retained
unchanged; monochrome display filters, size and the IIT Delhi button surface are set with CSS.
Retrieved 17 October 2026.

- `iit-delhi.png`: original white institute emblem from
  https://home.iitd.ac.in/images/logo-iit.png (official IIT Delhi homepage).
- `gmail.svg`: original Google product logo from
  https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/i/productlogos/gmail_2020q4/v8/192px.svg.
- `linkedin.png`: original black PNG from LinkedIn's official in-logo pack:
  https://content.linkedin.com/content/dam/me/business/en-us/amp/xbu/linkedin-revised-brand-guidelines/logos/in-logo.zip.
  Brand download page: https://brand.linkedin.com/downloads.
- `google-scholar.png`: original Google Scholar icon from
  https://scholar.google.com/apple-touch-icon.png, retained as an unused color option.
- `google-scholar.svg`: monochrome icon from Simple Icons 11.15.0:
  https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/simple-icons@11.15.0/icons/googlescholar.svg.
  Licensed CC0 1.0 Universal; see `simple-icons-LICENSE.txt` beside this file.
- `github.svg`: GitHub's Octicons mark, retrieved through the GitHub connector:
  https://github.com/primer/octicons/blob/main/icons/mark-github-16.svg.
  Source blob: `0e55a8ef2db1913cb35f81ae09ffdb58b5422319`.

The institute and product marks remain their owners' marks. This source bundle's
MIT license does not relicense those marks. GitHub Octicons' license follows.
